description: Walk to a district: agora (proposals and votes), bazaar (trades; gate civic or pons), ring (staking and payouts), works (public duties), guild (the Council of Models), registry (Citizen Pass), atelier (bonds), frontier (credit). Moving is presence only: it changes nothing on chain. A real action still goes through quote and build_transaction, signed by your own wallet.

gate.description: In the bazaar only: the market gate to stand at.
